resources.string: The battery layout depends on the model and version. Until a car is chosen, cell diagnostics are hidden. If the car reports a different number of cells, the check warns that the data does not match the chosen car.

While the car is on, the app saves the voltages of all %1$d cells and the temperatures of %2$d probes once per chosen interval. These snapshots build the «at rest», «after charging» and «under load» measurements and the history. Read-only: nothing is written to the car. The data is stored apart from the trips and charges database.
How often to take a snapshot

A snapshot is also taken right after the car is switched on (cells have «rested» while parked), after an hour of rest and under load — these are the most honest measurements. ≈ 0.5 KB per snapshot · at 30 s and 2 hours a day ≈ 0.1 MB a day
Measurements: at rest — %1$d, after charging — %2$d, under load — %3$d
All snapshots and measurements will be deleted (%1$s). Settings stay.
